description: Take a source added by hand or seen in traces out of force: what it stated stops counting as intended, and the judge no longer reviews against it. Its versions are kept, and it can be restored on the Sources tab. A source from the agent's code is retired by running the coding agent setup without it; one from the connection settings is changed there.

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

source.description: The source's id, as list_sources shows it.
source.title: Source

name: retire_source
